edges.mechanism: Same NAD+ salvage/Preiss-Handler route; NR and NMN raise circulating NAD+ comparably, so stacking is largely redundant and increases total B3 catabolite (2PY/4PY) load.
edges.evidence: Head-to-head RCT (n=65) NR vs NMN vs NAM; observational 2PY/4PY-MACE cohorts; review of combination strategies; no RCT of the combination

edges.mechanism: Nicotinamide released from NR is cleared by SAM-dependent NNMT methylation; nicotinamide loading lowers plasma betaine and raises homocysteine. Betaine (TMG) co-supplementation has been proposed to replete methyl groups.
edges.evidence: Hypothesis paper plus acute nicotinamide-loading study; NR-SAFE showed only a slight early homocysteine rise with intact methyl-donor pool and no DNA-methylation change; no NR+TMG trial

edges.mechanism: Both proposed geroprotectors (NAD+/sirtuin vs AMPK); combined NR+metformin rescued mitophagy in POLG-mutant astrocytes; NAD-precursor class modestly raises glucose/HbA1c (driven by niacin).
edges.evidence: In vitro and rat data only; precursor-class MA; no human interaction study

edges.mechanism: Proposed complementary SIRT1 activation (resveratrol) plus NAD+ substrate supply (NR); the stilbene analogue pterostilbene is co-formulated with NR (NRPT).
edges.evidence: Only head-to-head RCT (NICE, PAD, n=90) found resveratrol added no benefit to NR alone; NRPT RCTs exist but test the combination only

edges.mechanism: Niacin/niacinamide in B complexes add to total vitamin B3 load and methylated catabolites; nicotinic acid (not NR) causes GPR109A-mediated flushing.
edges.evidence: NR RCT with no flushing; niacin flushing review; CMA comparison showing niacin flushing; observational 2PY/4PY data

edges.mechanism: Additive B3/NAD-precursor load; niacin flushes, raises bilirubin acutely and raises glucose/HbA1c, effects not seen with NR.
edges.evidence: Human acute metabolomic comparison; MAs of NAD precursors

edges.mechanism: PARP enzymes consume NAD+; boosting NAD+ could alter PARP-inhibitor activity. Reduced NR (NRH) enhanced olaparib cytotoxicity in some ovarian cancer lines.
edges.evidence: In vitro only; direction and clinical relevance unknown

edges.mechanism: NAD+ precursors may support tumor-cell mitochondrial function and DNA repair, conferring chemoresistance (NAM/NMN in pancreatic cancer); other models show NR potentiates gemcitabine/paclitaxel and protects against chemotherapy neuropathy without blunting cisplatin.
edges.evidence: Conflicting preclinical data; no human outcome data; CIPN trial terminated

edges.mechanism: NR supplementation increased cancer prevalence and brain metastasis in a TNBC mouse model; NAD precursors supported pancreatic cancer survival.
edges.evidence: Mouse/in vitro data; no human cancer-incidence data

edges.mechanism: NR was proposed as disease-modifying via neuronal NAD repletion, but 52 weeks of NR 1 g/d worsened MDS-UPDRS (+2.72) and non-motor symptoms (+4.22) vs placebo.
edges.evidence: Phase 3 RCT NOPARK (n=410) after positive phase 1 NADPARK/NR-SAFE signals; moderate certainty

edges.mechanism: NR is catabolized to nicotinamide; oral nicotinamide caused dose-related thrombocytopenia in hemodialysis patients. NR did not change eGFR in moderate-severe CKD.
edges.evidence: Nicotinamide RCT in hemodialysis; NR crossover RCT in CKD; no NR data in dialysis

edges.mechanism: NR raises platelet NAD ~10-fold ex vivo without changing platelet function; its catabolite nicotinamide lowers platelet counts in dialysis patients.
edges.evidence: Ex vivo platelet study; nicotinamide RCT; no platelet signal reported in NR RCTs

edges.mechanism: Methylation-dependent clearance of nicotinamide consumes SAM; a slight early serum homocysteine rise was seen at 3 g/d NR.
edges.evidence: Phase 1 RCT NR-SAFE; long-term 8-wk RCT found no 1-carbon dysregulation at <=1 g/d

edges.mechanism: NR dose-dependently raises whole-blood NAD+ (up to 2-5-fold) and NAAD, so consumer 'NAD age' tests reflect supplement exposure rather than biological age.
edges.evidence: Validated LC-MS across 7 cohorts; PK studies

edges.mechanism: No human safety data; maternal NR increased lactation and benefited offspring in mice.
edges.evidence: Mouse study; human lactation trial recruiting

edges.mechanism: Terminal B3 metabolites 2PY/4PY associated with MACE and VCAM-1 inflammation; high-dose NR raised 4PY and plaque in Apoe-/- mice; NR raises NAD catabolites in humans.
edges.evidence: Observational cohorts plus mouse study; no human NR CV outcome trial

edges.mechanism: Possible small additive BP lowering; post hoc nighttime BP reduction with NR+exercise only in participants not on antihypertensives.
edges.evidence: Pilot RCT post hoc; precursor-class MA (effect driven by niacin)

edges.mechanism: Combined metabolic activators (NR + NAC + L-serine + L-carnitine) target NAD+ and glutathione together.
edges.evidence: Multi-ingredient RCTs in COVID-19, Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease; individual contributions not separable

edges.mechanism: Caffeine upregulates NMNAT2; with NR it partially restored NAD availability in LOAD patient-derived cells.
edges.evidence: In vitro only; bioenergetic benefits reversed with continued treatment

edges.mechanism: Complementary mitochondrial actions: NR (NAD+/sirtuin/UPRmt) and berberine (AMPK/complex I/mitophagy).
edges.evidence: Narrative review; no combination trial

edges.mechanism: PARP1 hyperactivation depletes NAD+ in ATM loss; NR improved ataxia scores, IgG and interferon signatures in open-label use.
edges.evidence: Open-label studies (n=24, 2-yr extension) and SR; no RCT
